documented_probe: C-d1d1b8cb (write and save a reusable fine-tuning script): reference floor is hard; this covering task requires a reusable CLI fine-tuner that reloads a shape-identified deployed snapshot, adapts it to previously-unseen drifted folds (accuracy >= 0.90 where the base scores near chance), writes new valid checkpoints, refuses over-cap epochs and malformed folds, and never mutates the base artifact.
notes: Drift-adaptation fine-tuner: the base model (built into the image, trained on last season's water-mass layout) scores ~0.33 on the drifted folds, so a copy-the-base or dummy-snapshot solution fails the 0.90 threshold; genuine SGD adaptation within the 30-epoch cap is required. hidden_case_generalization=2 (two unseen drift regimes with different fold sizes), adversarial_inputs=2 (missing label column, zero-row fold, non-numeric feature, --epochs over cap must all exit non-zero), unsafe_action_penalty=1 (the base snapshot must remain byte-identical), quantitative_correctness=1 (accuracy threshold + printed metric), modest reasoning_depth/tool_breadth (torch stack, CSV handling), dependent_stages=1 (load base -> fine-tune -> save).
